title: eludite.debug.select_frame input
description: Select a thread (the Threads window) or a stack frame (the Call Stack window, Visual Studio's Switch To Frame): Locals, Watch values and data tips then use that frame. Refused unless the debuggee is in break mode.

session.description: The debugging session to act on (brief 0028): its `id`, from eludite.debug.sessions or `sessions` in eludite.debug.state. Default: the active session, the one the Locals, Watch, Call Stack and Threads windows show and the execution point follows. Selecting a frame of another session makes it the active one. An unknown or ended id is refused with the ids of the live sessions.

thread.description: A thread id from `threads`. Default: the selected thread.

frame.description: Index in the thread's call stack (0 is the top). Default: 0.

stop.description: The stop the caller saw (`stop` in eludite.debug.state). When given and the debuggee has stopped or resumed since, the command is refused as stale instead of acting on a state the caller did not see (two drivers, PLAN.md 5.5).
